test_parse_since: test the _parse_since function to parse relative time strings like '1h', '30m', '2d' into datetime cutoffs
test_parse_line_timestamp: test the _parse_line_timestamp function to extract timestamps from standard log lines
test_extract_level: test the _extract_level function to extract log levels like INFO, WARNING, ERROR, DEBUG from log lines
test_extract_logger_name: test the _extract_logger_name function to extract logger names from log lines with optional session tags
test_matches_filters: test the _matches_filters function to apply combined level, session, component, and time filters to log lines
test_read_tail: test the _read_tail function to read filtered tail lines from log files
test_line_matches_component: test the _line_matches_component function to match log lines against component name prefixes
test_log_files: test the LOG_FILES registry contains known log file entries like agent, errors, gateway
